source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: On Windows, do_main reads MOZ_MAXSTDIO before XRE_main. A present value is parsed with atoi and passed to _setmaxstdio only when it falls between 3 and 8192. The return comparison controls the failure message. This is a standard-stream startup setting, not a general OS handle limit or strict whole-string validator. The -1 comparison sentinel leaves that parsed invalid value silent. No Windows run was performed.
title: Windows startup can read MOZ_MAXSTDIO before XRE_main
